Class GuiController

java.lang.Object
com.comp2042.controller.GuiController
All Implemented Interfaces:
GameInputReceiver, GameView, javafx.fxml.Initializable
public class GuiController extends Object implements javafx.fxml.Initializable, GameView, GameInputReceiver
JavaFX GUI controller implementing the game's view and input receiver. Coordinates renderers, overlays, timers, and forwards user input to the logic.
